free_tier.stated: New accounts receive USD 100.00 of one-time sign-up credit, no card needed to start. It is prepaid balance that does not reset monthly; whatever is left stays. Without a card an account can run up to 4 machines at once of up to 4 vCPU each.
free_tier.notes: The credit is granted once at signup, not monthly, and is held until the email address is verified. The standard plan has no monthly fee.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a Linux microVM, not an object; machine disk on the standard plan is not published

retention.stated: The machine filesystem persists across exec and stop/start; a stopped machine keeps its files and its held disk keeps billing. A recovery point is exported on an API or idle stop at no charge, but excludes /workspace.

egress.terms: USD 0.05 per GB out; an open outbound network or an allowCidrs list is set explicitly, and a stopped machine stops the base, CPU and memory meters while held disk keeps billing
egress.price_per_tb: USD 50 per TB at the published USD 0.05 per GB rate

interface_detail: The dashboard uses the same REST API a caller can use from code, with a bearer token from /console/keys; the SDKs and CLI are named smol and smolvm.
tooling: curl against the REST API with an SMOL_CLOUD_TOKEN, or the smol SDK and CLI; a saved key from smol auth login wins over the environment token.
chaining: A managed VM with a REST control plane and S3-compatible remote mounts can be driven by an agent SDK and checkpointed to external object storage, while the same workload runs locally through smolvm.

limits.value: USD 100.00 of one-time sign-up credit; standard plan allows 20 machines at once and 8 vCPU per machine

without a card an account can run up to 4 machines at once of up to 4 vCPU each; many accounts from the same email domain or network on one day create nothing until credit is added or auto-recharge is on
a machine with a published port and no autoStopSeconds can be stopped by the platform's idle default unless the plan includes always-on; /tmp and /run are emptied on each stop and start

limits_note: Every machine bills a one-minute minimum at the size requested; longer runs bill to the second. A machine larger than the plan allows is refused at create time with the limit in the reply. Disk is billed around the clock, including while stopped.
binding_note: The one-time USD 100.00 credit binds first: at the USD 0.04 machine-hour plus USD 0.05 vCPU-hour plus USD 0.0162 GB-hour and USD 0.0001 GB-hour disk rates it funds a few thousand machine-hours, while the 20-machine standard-plan ceiling is a separate create-time refusal.

identity_cost.detail: An email-and-password sign-up holds the credit until the address is verified and creates nothing until then unless credit is added or auto-recharge is turned on; no card is needed to start. Adding a card lifts the 4-machine / 4-vCPU no-card ceiling once the account has paid or is a day old.

reliability_note: A machine with a published port can be stopped on the platform's idle default without an explicit autoStopSeconds; a node loss loses memory and writes since the last recovery point, and /workspace comes back empty on restore.
confidence_note: Every rate, the sign-up credit, the no-card ceiling and the idle behaviour are quoted from the vendor's own pricing, quick-start and lifecycle pages read on 2026-11-24. smolvm itself is separate self-hostable software; this record prices the hosted smol cloud lane only.

notes: The hosted lane of smol machines' microVM engine: USD 100.00 of one-time credit at an email-only signup, no card needed to start, with usage-priced compute, memory, disk and egress. The one-minute billing minimum and the platform's idle stop of published-port machines are the practical clocks.

shape.note: standard plan ceiling of 8 vCPU and 16 GB per machine; the quick-start example creates 1 vCPU and 256 MB; no hosted GPU fields

extras.billing_model: usage-based: base per machine-hour, vCPU-hour, GB-hour of active RSS, GB-hour of used disk, per GB egress
extras.term: no monthly fee on the standard plan; credit does not reset
extras.price_arithmetic: USD 100.00 one-time credit; USD 0.04 per machine-hour plus USD 0.05 per vCPU-hour plus USD 0.0162 per GB-hour memory plus USD 0.0001 per GB-hour disk plus USD 0.05 per GB egress

network_out.ports: up to 16 published guest ports per machine, via authenticated connect route or login-free port links

session_cap.note: autoStopSeconds and ttlSeconds are set on create; the idle sweep runs every 15 seconds with an offset of up to about 75 seconds
